help.title: How Trampo Fácil works
help.intro: Trampo Fácil connects people who need a job done with professionals in the same area. You find, talk and agree on everything directly with them.

near.title: Find help near you
near.text: Find builders, electricians, cleaners and other professionals in your city in a few taps.

work.title: More work for local pros
work.text: Help local professionals show what they do and win new clients.

trust.title: Trust on both sides
trust.text: Photos of past work and real client ratings help you choose well.

step1.title: Search for the service
step1.text: Look for what you need and pick your city. You can also browse by category.

step2.title: Check the profile
step2.text: See photos of their work, where they work and what other clients said.

step3.title: Message on WhatsApp
step3.text: With your free account, talk to the professional directly and agree on price and date.

step4.title: Rate after the job
step4.text: Your rating helps others choose and rewards good work.

step1.title: Sign up
step1.text: Tell us what you do and which cities you work in. If your trade is missing, you can suggest it.

step2.title: Polish your profile
step2.text: Write a little about yourself and your experience. A complete profile builds trust.

step3.title: Show your work
step3.text: Add photos and videos of jobs you have done to your portfolio.

step4.title: Get clients
step4.text: Clients message you on WhatsApp. With 3 or more good ratings you can appear in "Best in the field".

account.q: Do I need an account to see professionals?
account.a: No. Browse freely. You only need an account to see a professional's contact, and it is free.

contact.q: How do I talk to a professional?
contact.a: On their profile, tap "See contact" to message them on WhatsApp. You agree on everything directly.

price.q: How much does a job cost?
price.a: You and the professional agree on the price. Trampo Fácil just helps you find each other.

ratings.a: After the job, the client gives a score from 1 to 5 and can leave a comment. Scores show on the professional's profile.

best.a: The list of the best-rated professionals. It takes at least 3 ratings to get in.

both.q: Can I hire and work with the same account?
both.a: Yes. Clients can become professionals from the menu, and professionals can switch between both modes.

review.a: When a professional suggests a new category or trade, it shows as "under review" until our team checks it.
